tim_output.campaign_summary: The FBI and CISA released a joint cybersecurity advisory on Androxgh0st, a Python-scripted malware that establishes botnets to identify and exploit vulnerable networks, primarily targeting .env files containing cloud service credentials (AWS, Office 365, SendGrid, Twilio) through exposed Laravel and PHPUnit installations. Threat actors exploiting CVE-2017-9841, CVE-2018-15133, and CVE-2021-41773 deploy web shells, exfiltrate credentials, and create AWS infrastructure for additional scanning and malicious operations. Organizations are advised to patch known exploited vulnerabilities, restrict URI access, rotate cloud credentials, and monitor for unauthorized access to environment files and unrecognized PHP files.

v2_entities.quote: Androxgh0st malware establishes a botnet to scan for websites using the Laravel web application framework.
For example, when threat actors successfully identify and compromise AWS credentials from a vulnerable website, they have been observed attempting to create new users and user policies [T1136].
Threat actors can identify uniform resource locators (URLs) for files outside root directory through a path traversal attack [T1083].
If the .env file is exposed, threat actors will issue a GET request to the /.env URI to attempt to access the data on the page.
